'''MSF-111''' was an [[MSF mouse droid]] that was manufactured on [[Uffel]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] that was inhabited entirely by [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. In c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the renegade droid [[LN-73]] attempted to shut down the Uffel droid factories, but was prevented from doing so by the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance [[Agent/Legends|agents]]. MSF-111 decided that he wanted the agents to take him with them when they left Uffel, and the other Uffel droids gave him permission.
